verdict.rationale: Eqvista is a SaaS equity-management platform. For a product like this, letting users opt out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The advanced permissions and visibility settings cited govern access to equity data, which is a different control and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
